title: CIA screening genetic databases for Nordic markers
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of CIA screening genetic databases for Nordic markers, about present at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A writer and researcher named Jason Jorjani, on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, relays what he says he was told, linking it to a man named Lyn Buchanan. According to Jorjani, Kit Green, a figure at the CIA, the US spy agency, runs a programme that taps into consumer DNA-testing services like 23andMe and Ancestry.com, looking for genetic traits of a so-called 'Nordic' type. If true, it would mean the agency is secretly searching people's DNA for a particular bloodline.
